rationale: The workflow already implements the dependency-caching optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) via `actions/setup-java@v4` with `cache: 'gradle'`, which caches the Gradle wrapper and dependency cache. Adding a separate `actions/cache` step for the same Gradle cache would be redundant and matches the pattern's contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists". No other supported optimization meets its preconditions: there is no matrix for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST; there is no completed-run history to derive a safe custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT / P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT require representative history, but ci_history shows no completed runs); change filtering, test/build selection, environment reuse, and Bazel patterns either lack reliable dependency/tracing data, risk reducing required coverage, or are not applicable to this Gradle/Android workflow. Build and test coverage is preserved as-is.
